Name: Lumisteria Insects Of Ferngill
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds several insects for Nature In The Valley!
Features :

- Adds more than 20 insects to find in various places and conditions!
- Cross Compatibility with Mount Vapius : find some insects earlier there. They all can appears in the valley too.
- Insects are rewarding, and may sometimes grant you resources.
- Additional rewards to obtain at the Insectarium.
- One event and one mail.
- Several conversation topics when catching some of the insects.
